# CIS International School

> Cambridge International School (CIS) is a premier bilingual international school with campuses in Moscow, St. Petersburg, and Tashkent, offering dual curriculum programs from Early Years through Sixth Form.

CIS provides Cambridge International education combined with Russian curriculum, serving expat and local families across three major cities in Russia and Central Asia. The school emphasizes international standards, global faculty, and preparation for leading universities worldwide.

- [Primary School](https://cisedu.com/ru-ru/academics/primary): Primary school program with international standards and bilingual environment.
- [Secondary School](https://cisedu.com/ru-ru/academics/secondary): Secondary school with IGCSE and A-Level preparation for top universities.
- [Sixth Form](https://cisedu.com/ru-ru/academics/sixth-form): Sixth Form program preparing students for leading universities worldwide.
- [Russian Curriculum](https://cisedu.com/ru-ru/academics/russian-curriculum): Russian education program combined with international approach at CIS.
- [Extracurricular Activities](https://cisedu.com/ru-ru/academics/after-school): Extracurricular activities and clubs for student talent and interest development.
